title: Delicious Polish Dumplings with Praline Sauce
description: Polish dumplings filled with a sweet and savory mixture, served with a rich praline sauce. Perfect for a cozy dinner or special occasion.

ingredients.name: Polish dumplings
ingredients.notes: available at most Polish markets or online

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the dumplings according to the package instructions.
Meanwhile, melt 2 tablespoons of butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the praline sauce and stir to combine.
Add the shredded cheddar cheese and stir until melted.
Stir in the sour cream and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Serve the dumplings with the praline sauce and top with chopped parsley if desired.
Melt the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter in a small saucepan over low heat.
Serve the melted butter on the side for added flavor.
